entries.title: II Samuel 22:1
segments: And David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:2
segments: And he said, The LORD [is] my Rock, and my Fortress, and my Deliverer.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:3
segments: The God who is my Rock, in Him will I trust. [He is] my Shield, and the Horn of my salvation, my High Tower, and my Refuge, my Savior. You save me from violence.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:4
segments: I will call upon the LORD, [who is] worthy to be praised. And I shall be saved from my enemies.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:5
segments: When the waves of death encircled me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:6
segments: The sorrows of hell hemmed me in. The snares of death went in front of me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:7
segments: In my distress I called upon the LORD and cried to my God. And he heard my voice out of His temple, and my cry [entered] into His ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:8
segments: And the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of the heavens moved and shook because He was angry.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:9
segments: Smoke went up out of His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth devoured. Coals were kindled by it.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:10
segments: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. And darkness [was] under His feet.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:11
segments: And He rode upon a cherub and did fly. And [He] was seen upon the wings of the wind.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:12
segments: And He made darkness coverings around Him, dark waters, thick clouds of the skies.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:13
segments: From the brightness before Him were coals of fire kindled.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:14
segments: The LORD thundered from the heavens, and the Most High uttered His voice.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:15
segments: And He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and troubled them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:16
segments: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were uncovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:17
segments: He sent from above, He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:18
segments: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were stronger than I.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:19
segments: They went before me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my stay.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:20
segments: He brought me forth also into a large place. He delivered me because He delighted in me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:21
segments: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands He has rewarded me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:22
segments: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:23
segments: For all His judgments [were] before me. And as for His statutes, I did not depart from them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:24
segments: I was also upright before Him, and have kept myself from my iniquity.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:25
segments: And the LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His eyes.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:26
segments: With the faithful You will show Yourself faithful; with the upright man You will show Yourself upright.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:27
segments: With the pure You will show Yourself pure; and with the perverted You will appear perverse.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:28
segments: And You will save the afflicted people, but Your eyes [are] on the proud, [whom] You bring low.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:29
segments: For You [are] my lamp, O LORD. And the LORD will lighten my darkness.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:30
segments: For by You I have run [through] a troop. By my God I have leaped over a wall.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:31
segments: [As for] God, His way [is] perfect. The word of the LORD [is] tried. He is a shield to all those who seek refuge in Him.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:32
segments: For who [is] God, except Jehovah? And who [is] a rock except our God?

entries.title: II Samuel 22:33
segments: God [is] my strength [and] power, and He makes my way perfect.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:34
segments: [He] makes my feet like hinds' [feet], and causing me to stand on my high places.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:35
segments: He teaches my hands to war, so that my hands may bend a bow of bronze.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:36
segments: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation, and Your gentleness has made me great.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:37
segments: You have enlarged my steps under me, so that my feet did not slip.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:38
segments: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them, and turned not again until I had finished them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:39
segments: And I have crushed them and wounded them so that they could not rise. [Yea], they have fallen under my feet.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:40
segments: For You have girded me [with] strength to battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:41
segments: You have also given me the necks of my enemies; I silenced those who hate me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:42
segments: They looked, but [there was] none to save; to the LORD, but He did not answer them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:43
segments: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I stamped them like the mire of the streets [and] spread them out.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:44
segments: You have also delivered me from the strivings of my people, You have kept me the head of the nations. A people I knew not shall serve me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:45
segments: Strangers shall submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear, they shall obey me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:46
segments: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their strongholds.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:47
segments: The LORD lives! And blessed [be] my Rock, and exalted be the God, the Rock of my salvation.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:48
segments: It [is] God who avenges me and who brings down the peoples under me,

entries.title: II Samuel 22:49
segments: and who brings me forth from my enemies. You also lift me up on high above those rising up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:50
segments: Therefore, I will give thanks to You, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises to Your name.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:51
segments: [He is] the Tower of salvation for His king, and He shows mercy to His anointed, to David and to his seed, forevermore.
